conventions.commits: Conventional commits with type prefixes (feat, fix, chore, test, docs); signed commits required; DCO enforced
conventions.testing: Unit tests in language handler modules; integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/; test patterns: parse code snippet, find node by kind, validate query matches and extraction logic
conventions.linting: cargo clippy with -D warnings; workspace lints deny undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used (with test exemptions); cargo fmt --check enforced
conventions.error_handling: thiserror for error types; Result<T> returns; no unwrap/expect in production code (test exemptions via cfg_attr); bounds checks on node byte ranges

patterns: Language handlers live in crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/<lang>.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY constants
Each language registers via get_language_info() match arm in mod.rs, wiring tree-sitter::Language and query strings to LanguageInfo struct
File extension mapping in crates/aptu-coder-core/src/lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP; language_for_extension() lookup used by analyze_file()
Tree-sitter queries use @capture syntax to tag nodes; ELEMENT_QUERY captures @function/@class/@interface/@enum; DEFUSE_QUERY captures @write.* and @read.* for def-use analysis
extract_inheritance() walks class/interface nodes to find base_clause and class_interface_clause children, extracting name nodes
Handler functions (extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance) are Option<FnPtr> in LanguageInfo; None for languages without that capability

constraints: All languages unconditionally compiled in; no lang-* Cargo features (removed in recent refactor)

EXTENSION_MAP must include .php extension mapping to 'php' language identifier
get_language_info() and get_ts_language() match arms must be exhaustive or have explicit catch-all
DEFUSE_QUERY is required for def-use analysis; must cover local variable declarations, assignments, and identifier reads
No unsafe code without SAFETY comments; no unwrap/expect in production paths
test_coverage: Existing language tests cover: query compilation and matching (ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY), extraction functions (extract_function_name, extract_inheritance), receiver type finding, inheritance parsing. CSS tests verify rule set and import extraction. Java tests verify method/class/interface/enum extraction and inheritance with extends/implements. All tests use tree-sitter Parser directly, parse code snippets, and validate captured nodes.

approaches.name: Minimal PHP handler (CSS-like pattern)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, enum_declaration), CALL_QUERY (function_call_expression, member_call_expression), IMPORT_QUERY (include/require statements), no DEFUSE_QUERY, no handler functions. Register in mod.rs get_language_info() and get_ts_language(), add .php to EXTENSION_MAP in lang.rs, add tree-sitter-php to workspace.dependencies.

approaches.name: Full PHP handler with inheritance and def-use (recommended)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY covering all declaration kinds, CALL_QUERY for function/method calls, IMPORT_QUERY for includes, DEFUSE_QUERY for local variable declarations and assignments (adapted from Java pattern), extract_inheritance() handler walking base_clause and class_interface_clause children to extract extends/implements names. Register all components in mod.rs, add .php to EXTENSION_MAP, add tree-sitter-php to workspace.dependencies. Include comprehensive tests for all query patterns and handler functions.
pros: Enables def-use analysis for PHP code

approaches.name: Phased approach: basic first, handlers later
approaches.description: Phase 1: Add minimal php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY only; register in mod.rs and lang.rs; add tree-sitter-php dependency. Phase 2 (follow-up PR): Add DEFUSE_QUERY constant and extract_inheritance() handler; add corresponding tests.
pros: Allows review and feedback on basic structure
Handlers can be refined in follow-up
Easier to debug and test incrementally
cons: Requires two PRs instead of one
May not meet issue requirements in one go

recommendation: Approach 2 (Full PHP handler with inheritance and def-use). This approach delivers complete language support aligned with the project's standards (Java/Kotlin parity), enables all analysis modes (symbol extraction, def-use, inheritance), and satisfies the issue requirement to 'model after java.rs'. The DEFUSE_QUERY is required because def-use analysis is a core feature of aptu-coder; omitting it would leave PHP incomplete relative to other languages. Implementation complexity is medium but well-understood from existing handlers.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
pub const ELEMENT_QUERY: &str = r"
(function_definition
  name: (name) @function_name) @function
(method_declaration
  name: (name) @method_name) @function
(class_declaration
  name: (name) @class_name) @class
(interface_declaration
  name: (name) @interface_name) @class
(enum_declaration
  name: (name) @enum_name) @class
";
defuse_query_draft:
pub const DEFUSE_QUERY: &str = r"
(assignment_expression left: (variable_name) @write.assign)
(assignment_expression left: (subscript_expression) @write.subscript)
(augmented_assignment_expression left: (variable_name) @writeread.augmented)
(foreach_statement value: (variable_name) @write.foreach)
(global_declaration (variable_name) @write.global)
(static_declaration (variable_name) @write.static)
(variable_name) @read.usage
";
inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-php node-types.json: class_declaration has a 'name' field (type: name, required) and children array containing optional base_clause and class_interface_clause. base_clause children are name/qualified_name/relative_name nodes representing the extends parent. class_interface_clause children are name/qualified_name/relative_name nodes representing implements interfaces. Walk: class_declaration -> child_by_field_name('name') for class name; iterate children to find base_clause -> iterate its children to extract name nodes for extends; find class_interface_clause -> iterate its children to extract name nodes for implements.
